notes.title: Holy Wars Update is live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520137/cecfbcc2a85ef23b487419e68bceda086fb15160.jpg[/img]

[b]It's finally here! [/b]

We worked hard to bring you Skirmish that would be fun and challenging and we can finally share with you the results. 

[h1]Holy Wars Skirmish Mode [/h1]
It consists of 3 maps, several AI strategies ranging from Defensive to Conquer and 4 difficulty settings (from Easy to Nightmare) for more challenging or more laid back playthrough experience. 

[h1]Slow-mo[/h1]
Holy Wars brings a real game changer (literally) in a form of Slow-Mo. You are now able to slow down time and react to every threat in a more calm and strategic manner than before. 

This update includes many fixes and updates like: improved AI, improved pathfinding, better mini-map, better alerting system and more! 

[h1]Holy Wars Explanation Video[/h1]
We prepared a video explaining all the new features and changes that we made. Take a look! 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pqzMgOvD9Z4
And that’s all for now! You'll find a detailed changelog below. Thanks for your continued support! 

[b]PS To sweeten the deal: Re-Legion is 50% off! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/782140/ReLegion/

[h1]Re-Legion: Holy Wars: Significant changes we made since the release[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Completely new skirmish mode has been added.[/b]
[*] The gameplay can now be slowed down by entering the Slow-Mo. Default Slow-Mo hotkey is bind to [i]Left-alt[/i].
[*] Prophet can now enter Convert Stance that allows him to seek out and convert enemies and neutral units around him.
[*] [b]Game supports Autosaves which can be now turned on in the Settings Menu.[/b]
[*] [b]The minimap can now be expanded by pressing "M" or the little "+" button next to it.[/b]
[*] [b]Using skills depends on unit’s current Faith threshold.[/b]
[*] Rally point functionality has been added.
[*] Improvement of Unit Targeting and Alerting system.
[*] Improvement of Pathfinding system.
[*] HUD: Control Panel Update: Several functionalities have been updated, like: Font, Cooldowns & Progress bars.
[*] After each game on both Campaign and the Holy Wars new Summary Screen will be displayed.
[*] Keybinds are fully customizable.
[*] Tooltips have been updated, and give much more information about objects now.
[*] Tooltips for resources were added.
[*] Saving the game is now significantly faster.
[*] Active Strategy will now be highlighted in the Control Panel.
[*] The look of the units health bars have been updated.
[*] Building hacking update - now hacking is dependant on the amount of units hacking it and it is longer.
[*] Glossary name has been changed to Database and have been updated with images.
[*] Unit selection update: now the player can add or remove units from his group with [Shift + Click] on UI portrait.
[*] Minimap has been redesigned.
[*] Citizen animation update.
[*] Progress Bars of buildings have been updated.
[*] Action, Skill and Anointment buttons were standardized between Units and Buildings and are layed out better now.
[*] Player can now cancel the anoint by using the 'Cancel' Action in Control Panel.
[*] Better Synchronization of Damage Dealing mechanics and visualization.
[*] Camera now will center on the Story Characters before they die.
[*] Non-cutscene Dialog Panels close automatically along VoiceOvers end.
[*] Quest notifications were visually updated, making them more noticeable and matching the rest of UI.
[*] Destructible Objects now have Detail Panels and Portraits.
[*] Every time you try to take action that would result in changing settings, or navigating to different part of the game the confirmation popup will emerge.
[*] Clicking anywhere on quest panel (top-left corner of HUD) centers camera on Quest's objective.
[*] God is With Us skill update: visual effects for units affected by the skill, and AOE indicator.
[*] Language can now be set in steam settings.
[*] [RU] Language has been updated.
[*] [PL] Language has been added.
[*] "Saving in progress" notification was added.
[*] Hacking and Converting distances have been updated.
[*] ‘Go to Main Menu’ Button was added to Pause Menu.
[*] ‘Go to Main Menu’ Button was added to Mission Summary Screen.
[*] Cult Symbols were added to Tooltips.
[*] Falin - HP and Damage rebalanced, new skills added to compensate for his hyper-aggressive behaviour.
[*] Penitent’s Danse Macabre is not a group skill anymore. When the skill is triggered while more than 1 Penitent is selected, only one of them will use the attack.
[/list]

notes.title: Skirmish Closed Beta is live! [+tips&tricks for Re-Legion]
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520137/08610ad4bf63d29ff47436a8f843ea9d4ada86b2.jpg[/img]

Hey guys! 

Skirmish Closed Beta is now live and it will end on May 27th [9:00 UTC/13:00 PDT]. After that we'll post an update with plans for the future.

Every person that we chose to take part in this beta should get information about how to enter on their email shortly.


[h1]About Skirmish Closed Beta[/h1]

Closed beta is a chance for us to show you what we've been working on and get your early feedback before we release a final version for everyone to play. 

[b]Important note:[/b] There are two features that we want you to take a closer look at. 
[list]
[*] Slow motion that you can go in and out of by pushing Left Alt Key
[*] Prophet's strategy toggle between attack and auto-convert under Caps Lock Key. 
[/list]

[b]You can still join the beta: [/b]

The easiest way to join the beta is to[url=https://forms.gle/T9gX3Qh7ME7vSPXy5] fill out this form[/url]. 

We'll contact everyone that we'll decide to invite to the beta through an email with an explanation about the next steps. 

[u]Please note that beta will be available for people who already own a copy of Re-Legion.[/u]

Thank you for your support and stay tuned for future updates here on Steam and on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/ReLegionGame/]Facebook page[/url]. 

[h1]We also prepared some Tips&Tricks for new and returning players[/h1]

[b]1.Sanctuary[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520137/b90f2c692096d5b1dbcd2725da66efd75a881a55.png[/img]

First of all remember to keep your eyes on Sanctuary which is your main base and headquarter. If enemy destroy the building than well… game over. Sanctuary also automatically heals your troops, that are around and serves, by default, as a rally point for all your new Followers. It is also a place where you can resurrect your Prophet after his death in battle.

[b]2. Converting[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520137/ee6fbddca3fcc0c62397aa59ecb7f95abbc36b4a.png[/img]

In every Cult the most important are Followers. To build your religion and your army you need people, believers, souls. As The Prophet you can convert neutral Citizens or even enemy units to join your side, simply by right-clicking on them. You can also perform a Sermon, which fills with Faith all units that are around you and by that you can convert a whole group of Citizens or weak heretics. Of course you don’t have to do all of that by yourself. Irreplaceable Preachers can help you in the fight for new souls, but more about them later.

[b]3. Anointing[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520137/ba0ac67be0499abab1c284a9e42ab4649d923239.png[/img]

Newly converted Followers are weak and not useful in a fight. They can serve only as cannon fodder, unless you Anoint them. You can do that by selecting Follower and clicking on proper icon in control panel. Chosen believer will change into more powerful, fighting unit like Fanatic, range unit like Purifier or unstoppable Ascendent One. You can also turn Followers into non-fighting, but equally important units like Worshipers, Hackers and mentioned Preachers. The last ones can convert neutral Citizens and enemy units to your Cult, so they’re necessary on every battlefield. Remember that Anointing costs Faith and Crypto, also not all units are unlocked in the beginning. You can gain access to more Anoints by hacking special buildings.

[b]4. Resource Buildings[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520137/1d2d7171a1bfc89623e825d9e4d46e2f8664d0d8.png[/img]

No Prophet or general won a war without resources. In Re-Legion you can find three: Faith, Crypto anc Citizens. They’re necessary for Anoints, upgrades and using skills. You can get Faith from buildings called Temples if you’ll assign them with some Worshipers to pray in your name around the building. Followers provide you small amount of Faith also by gathering and praying around Sanctuary. You can get Crypto on similar terms from CryptoBank if you’ll assign some Hackers to dig dirty money from the dark web. In both buildings you can by default assign only four units, but if you’ll upgrade the building you can assign more. The more Worshipers/Hackers are connected to the building the more resources they provide. Remember to protect your source of resources or your fight will end quicker than expected!

[b]5. Other special buildings[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520137/a086fa50c98c288f86013aafda977a37d1028d58.png[/img]

Besides of Temples and CryptoBanks there are many other special buildings on the map like GunShops, Dojos or Black Clinics. You can take control over them by hacking them. You can do it, as The Prophet, or you can send hackers to do it for you. Remember, the more special buildings you control, the more units you can have. Also those structures unlock extra upgrades and special skills for your units. Controlling special buildings is one of the most important aspects of the fight for The City, do not underestimate your enemy and aim to at least control more buildings than they do.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0.258 is live! Improved HUD, minimap, bugfixes and more!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520137/2fa9d5646195bd1fd73769e7154034008ad57628.jpg[/img]

Hey guys, 

This time we have a huge patch with a long list of changes, fixes and improvements. 

We publish it in hope that your overall experience will be smoother and more enjoyable. If you encounter any more problems [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/782140/discussions/1/]issues and fixes board[/url] is here for your convinience. 

[h1]Re-Legion 1.1.0.258 changelog[/h1]

[h1]Major Improvements[/h1]
[list][*] [b]Saving the game is now significantly faster[/b]

[*] [b]Major HUD update[/b]

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520137/493b30b544c63b231dc08211b85f89a39e8a8a38.png[/img]

[*] Improvement of Unit Targeting and Alerting system

[*] Improvement of Pathfinding system

[*] Key binds are fully customizable

[*] Better Synchronization of Damage Dealing mechanics and visualization
[/list]

[b]Gameplay improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Turrets and Drones are no longer counted towards the Population Limit
[*] Turrets and Drones will now destroy themselves if the Hacker that created them perishes 
[*] Ascended One’s and War Machine’s spatial UI and shadows were updated
[*] Units should no longer get lost during walking nearby the corners
[*] Hacker no longer get stuck between other Hacker and the CryptoBank while trying to reach his working place
[*] Units alert system should work more naturally
[*] We have updated the Priority list of units for Tab-Scroll
[*] Camera now will center on the Story Characters before they die
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Action, Skill and Anointment buttons were standardized between Units and Buildings and are layed out better now
[*] Control Panel will no longer return to Basic Anointments from Advanced Anointments when one of the selected Followers perish
[*] Player can now cancel the anoint by using the 'Cancel' Action in Control Panel
[*] Active Strategy will now be highlighted in the Control Panel
[*] Tooltips have been updated, and give much more information about objects now
[*] Tooltips for resources were added
[*] Cult Symbols were added to Tooltips
[*] Quest notifications were visually updated, making them more noticeable and matching the rest of UI
[*] Progress Bars of buildings have been updated
[*] Destructible Objects now have Detail Panels and Portraits
[*] Locked Glossary entries are visualized now
[/list]

 
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[b]Gameplay Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Followers that are in the process of Anointing will now remember the movement commands that are ordered during the anointment
[*] Creating the Shrine on top of the unit no longer causes the unit to be stuck inside of it
[*] Units no longer deny the second command ordered with RMB whenever the first command was a movement command
[*] Selecting all units of the same type by using the double click now requires the player to click twice on the same unit
[*] Shift + Drag Select now adds and subtracts properly
[*] Citizens no longer get stuck in a convert position when the conversion was not finished
[*] Prophets Aura skill now increases and decreases current HP of the Prophet correctly
[*] Purifiers Blessed Shot ability can no longer be used on allied units
[*] Ascended One unit will now shoot enemies from full distance when on Attack Position command
[*] Units will no longer stop during the move attack before they reach the destination point
[*] Shereen is no longer bombarded at the start of Mission 6
[*] Player can no longer add neutral and enemy units to the control groups
[*] Player is no longer able to load game twice in a row and softlock the game
[*] Selecting vast number of units will no longer cause a mini freeze of the game
[/list]
 
[b]UI Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Minimap no longer has gaps on which the player cannot click
[*] Resource Bar of the Gun Shop is no longer too high
[*] Units Bars are no longer visible through the Detail Panel
[*] Loading Mission 2 before receiving "Hack the Gun Shop" quest will no longer cause the player to get stuck in the mission progres
[*] Loading Mission 2 before receiving "Anoint 3 Followers to Purifiers" quest will no longer cause the quest to appear before it is supposed to
[*] Minimap will now display both Dojos during quest "Hack the Dojo" quest on Mission 3
[*] Map Pointers of the units that perish are no longer displayed forever on the Mini Map
[*] T.I.S. now appears in Glossary 
[*] Falin no longer appears twice in Glossary 
[*] Load Menu is no longer displayed after loading the game from Main Menu
[/list]

[b]Thank you for your support and may Ellion guide you to salvation![/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5.221 - Rally point, new minimap, Polish language and more!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520137/e289f0ced7cbfe83014d7a22943b1eae234e0c5b.jpg[/img]

Hey guys,

We continue our work to improve Re-Legion. We managed to put in some stuff that you asked for already and have a few more functions that we'll add in the next patch. 

[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[b]Rally Point [/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520137/4ac8f621afcf383d84d89bf941cbddead0d0167c.png[/img]
You can choose a builing and set is as a rally point for newly converted citizens to gather around it. Note: you can set many rally points which will result in units gathering around the closest one on their path. 

[b]Improved minimap [/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520137/1f17afdd1f72205179aeddfaca16745600b53709.png[/img]
We redesigned the minimap to be more readable. It now shows the city better, you see all special buildings, your units and enemy units in sight. Sectors of the city are collored with purple (if yours), red (if enemy's). 

[b]Polish language support [/b]
Cieszymy się, że od teraz gracze z Polski mogą cieszyć się Re-Legionem w swoim języku. :)

[h1]Re-Legion 1.0.5.221 changelog[/h1]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Rally point funcionality has been added
[*] Minimap has been redesigned
[*] Ascended One - unit interface & selection update
[*] Unit Pointers - Animation & visual effects update
[*] Citizen animation update
[*] Language can now be set in steam settings
[*] [RU] Language has been updated and re-implemented
[*] [PL] Language has been added
[*] Building hacking update - now hacking is dependant on the amount of units hacking it and it is longer
[*] Hacking and Converting distances have been updated
[*] HUD: Control Panel Update: Several functionalities have been updated, like: Font, Cooldowns & Progress bars
[*] Unit selection update: now the player can add or remove units from his group with [Shift + Click] on UI portrait
[*] God is With Us skill update: visual effects for units affected by the skill, and AOE indicator	
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fibonacci decals issue - Using Sermon near the Fibonacci Temple caused VFX issues
[*] Mission 2: Color handlers - taking over a bank caused issues with color changes of other buildings
[*] Mission 1: Selecting Elion could cause issues when trying to select an enemy to attack, causing Elion not to engage
[*] Skill buttons - Sacrifice Dogma could sometimes overlap with other skills causing problem when wanting to select a proper skill
[*] Minimap: Clicking in the vicinity of minimap sometimes caused problems that the game did not recognize where should the unit go. Currently only clicking within the borders of the minimap causes the units to go to the selected point.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.207 out now! [We also added Steam Trading Cards!]
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32520137/00ec4e3d58036d79bb70ad938be46ddb15f6faac.jpg[/img]

Hey guys, 


Thank you again for all your feedback and reports. It really helps us to fix what needs to be fixed in Re-Legion. 

It's a first big patch since the launch but we don't intend to stop. We have a next update scheduled to be dropped next week so stay with us.  

From other news we just added [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] so you can spruce up your collection!

[h1]Re-Legion changelog - 06.02.2019[/h1]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Falin - HP and Damage rebalanced, new skills added to compensate for his hyper-aggressive behaviour.
[*] Penitent’s Danse Macabre is not a group skill anymore. When the skill is triggered while more than 1 Penitent is selected, only one of them will use the attack.
[*] Sanctuary - healing range displays when mouse cursor hovers over the building.
[*] Mission 1 Intro can be skipped after 8 seconds now.
[*] Clicking anywhere on quest panel (top-left corner of HUD) centers camera on Quest's objective.
[*] "Saving in progress" notification was added.
[*] Controls and Glossary buttons added to Pause Menu.
[*] Build Version - transferred from HUD to Pause Menu.
[*] Non-cutscene Dialog Panels close automatically along VoiceOvers end.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Mission 1 - Shereen was not autohealing. 
[*] Mission 1 - Elion didn’t Follow Falin in the cutscene where they meet for the first time.
[*] Mission 2 - Quest ''Locate Phreak'' can now be triggered by any unit (previously could only be triggered by the Prophet)
[*] Mission 3 - visual bug after forcing Fibonacci cultists into submission fixed.
[*] Mission 4 - visual bug after killing Drug Dealers fixed.
[*] Mission 4 - Outro Cutscene was triggering game over. 
[*] Mission 7 - Shereen was getting stuck in a dark alley.
[*] Sanctuary was not exploding properly when destroyed.
[*] Snipershot target indicator stayed on enemies after the skill was used. 
[*] Cursor has been disappearing if the Martyr died while targeting a skill. 
[*] Pausing the game did not block Skill hotkeys. 
[*] Squad Hotkeys were centering camera on wrong squads. 
[*] Double clicking the Squads in UI was not centering the camera on selected Squad.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and may Ellion guide you to salvation!
